title: Ordinary coefficient square for the proper/open gamma
statement: Fix l,E,o,a and ordinary inputs K for expressions over a scheme B [def-sf-integral-realization-assembly-data, def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain]. In a commutative square k:U→V, r:U→W, p:V→Z, i:W→Z over B, assume k and i are quasi-compact open immersions and r and p proper. For any child expression e on U, rho_(J_i S_r e) followed by the specified system gamma equals R of the independently specified ordinary ringed gamma followed by rho_(S_p J_k e). Here rho is constructed by ordinary coefficient recursion [def-sf-integral-ordinary-expression-reduction]. No realization comparison, completion map, inverse structural generator, exchange or projection case occurs.

source.place: The maps used here are tensor reassociation, evaluation, and adjunction units and counits, whose coefficient comparisons are proved in lem-fix-operation-reduction; coherence inherited from individual maps.

proof.text: Use fixedOpenReduction_isIso to invert the actual open reduction mate on every ordinary integral object. The inverse is natural, giving the ordinary open coefficient transformation. Derive its open composition and inverse-unit squares by the mate composition and unit identities, using the normalized pull composition square. Equality transports follow by substitution.

For the cartesian open square of p and i, invert the vertical sides of the ordinary beta inverse square. Apply mateEquiv to this equality under the composite open/direct adjunctions. Mate conjugation and composition identify the resulting square with the ordinary coefficient square of cartesianConjugate.

For the clopen lift s into the pullback, paste open composition and equality transport and invert that square. Restrict it along the pulled-back open and use the inverse open-unit square to obtain the restrictFactor square. Use the ordinary canonical clopen and proper-composition squares for the remaining factors; direct-image equality transport follows by substitution.

Paste the five factor squares to obtain the forward lambda square. Invert its horizontal isomorphisms. The specified ringed and system gamma adjunct equations identify their transposes with inverse lambda. Apply the inverse open-mate square to transpose the inverse lambda square back to the gamma coefficient square.

Evaluate the resulting primitive gamma square on the ringed object of e. Naturality of system gamma inserts the recursively constructed ordinary coefficient map of e. Expanding the two outer unary recursion equations gives exactly ordinaryProperOpenSquare.

proof_origin.place: H3: explicit ordinary mate-conjugation, clopen factorization and five-factor lambda pasting, followed by open adjunction transposition. No completion or finite-word admissibility theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryProperOpenSquare
    (o : Operations l E) (a : AmbientModels l E o)
    {B : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {X : I → Over B}
    (K : ∀ i, Integral l E (X i).left)
    {U V W Z : Over B} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W) (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z)
    [hk : IsOpenImmersion k.left] [hi : IsOpenImmersion i.left]
    [qk : QuasiCompact k.left] [qi : QuasiCompact i.left]
    [hr : IsProper r.left] [hp : IsProper p.left]
    (w : k.left ≫ p.left = r.left ≫ i.left) (e : Expression B I X U) :
    (Expression.shriek i hi qi (.push r hr e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K ≫
      (a.properOpen.gamma k.left r.left p.left i.left w).app
        (e.systemObj l E o ((inputReduction l E X).obj K)) =
    (calculus l E Z.left).reduction.map
        ((a.ringedProperOpen.gamma k.left r.left p.left i.left w).app
          (e.ringedObj l E a.ringedModels K)) ≫
      (Expression.push p hp (.shriek k hk qk e)).ordinaryReduction l E o a K
